datasheet.title: CMDUCT2U data sheet: Horizontal 2U Server Rack Cable Management Finger Duct w/ Cover

description: 2U horizontal finger duct, StarTech.com CMDUCT2U: a black steel and plastic plate the full width of the rack carrying a duct 71.6 mm deep. A wall of fifteen fingers runs along its top and another along its bottom, and a removable cover latches across their tips. Three rectangular pass-through holes in the plate lead cables through to the other side.

gaps.note: the datasheet, the drawing and the quick-start guide state no cable capacity, no fill and no cable count.
gaps.wanted: a cable capacity table, or a stated fill, for the finger duct

gaps.note: the quick-start guide says each corner has a latch that keeps the cover in place, and the drawing marks a small tab at each end of the cover; no view dimensions a latch, and the format has no latch, so the cover is on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of a cover latch, fitted and released

gaps.note: the datasheet says the duct is "Steel and Plastic" and does not say which part is plastic; the cover is drawn in the same black as the duct and no material is stated for it.
gaps.wanted: the material of the cover and of the walls

gaps.note: the drawing's end view shows the cover's edges notched where they meet the walls; no section is dimensioned and no gauge is stated, so the cover is drawn as a plate with two straight lips 1.0 mm thick (estimated).
gaps.wanted: a section through the cover and a finger tip

name: cmduct2u

attrs.note: datasheet - the material (steel and plastic), colour, standard (EIA RS310-D) and what is in the box are the datasheet's; the quick-start guide lists four screws, four cage nuts and four plastic washers.

capacity.note: no document states a cable capacity: the datasheet, the drawing and the quick-start guide are silent, so none is stated and a gap says so.

chassis.note: drawing - 482.6 x 88.45 x 71.6, the 1U duct's plate and duct made 2U high. The plate is the whole width of the rack, its two ends the ears, so the face is drawn whole with its four slots (L43 stands down above 480 mm). The datasheet's "Width 2.8 in" is the 71.6 depth and its "Height 3.5 in" the 88.5.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". The drawing is line work, so the shades are this library's render of black, the cover a little lighter than the duct.

cover.note: datasheet - "a removable top cover that makes it easy to add or remove bundled cables quickly"; the quick-start guide says it "can be removed for installation or upgrades" and latches with four latches. It is drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the plate, and the duct stands out of the other face of it: the drawing's side view puts the plate at one end of the 71.60 and the cover at the other, and the datasheet says "Front Mount (Front Only)". So the plate is the ear plane, nothing stands behind the rail, and `at` is 71.6. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the duct from its open side: the cover over the duct and the plate behind it, the ear slots at the four corners. The cover ships fitted, as the datasheet and the quick-start guide picture it, and is a part that comes off (`cover-off`).

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the whole duct stands in front of the rail, 71.6 mm, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct is the channel between the two finger walls, run across the rack, the 435.00 between the ears and 86.45 clear between the walls; its finger gap is the 11.00 the drawing dimensions and its pitch the 27.84 estimated above.

left.note: drawing - the end view: the plate at the rear, the two finger walls standing out of it and the cover's face and lips over their tips. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DRAWING. StarTech.com publishes CMDUCT2U_Diagram.pdf (third angle projection, "DO NOT SCALE", millimetres, uploaded 1/22/2026): a front, a rear and a side view, with the dimensions 482.60, 435.00, 71.60, 88.45, 465.00, 75.95, 13.00, 11.00 and "phi 6.50". The datasheet (cmduct2u_datasheet.pdf) lists "Product Length 19.0 in [48.3 cm]", "Product Width 2.8 in [71.6 mm]" and "Product Height 3.5 in [88.5 mm]"; the drawing's 88.45 is the same figure to the datasheet's rounding. What the drawing does not dimension - the slot pitch and the pass-through holes - is scaled off it at 2.6 px/mm against its own dimensions, and is estimated.

passes.note: estimated - the three rectangular holes, 100 by 69 mm, scaled off the drawing's rear view. They lie under the cover, which is a lid, so they are declared where the cover can be taken off.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the plate, with the ear slots 465.00 apart and 75.95 apart and three rectangular holes between them with rounded corners, which the datasheet calls "pass-through holes at the back". The holes are not dimensioned: scaled at 2.606 px/mm against the 465.00, three rectangles 100 by 69 mm on a 140 pitch, centred on the plate (estimated). They are rectangles here and ovals on the 1U.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states a gauge. 1.0 mm is taken for the plate, the walls and the cover, as on the CMDUCT1UX.

top.note: drawing - an elevation, rear at the top of the drawing: the plate, the finger wall with fifteen slots and the cover over the front 21.7 mm, as the 1U's. The slots are 11.00 wide; their pitch (27.84) is counted and scaled off the drawing at 2.61 px/mm against the 435.00 and is estimated. The drawing shows one wall in plan, the end view shows two, and the quick-start guide says the fingers are "available along the length on both sides": both walls are the same, so the bottom is the top again, the top and the bottom of the one open face.
